name: DiceDB (Legacy)
description: Open-source maintainer of DiceDB, an in-memory database written in Go (Aug 2024 – Jan 2025). Contributed 40+ pull requests (9,000+ lines), from nested JSONPath fixes to Set, Hash and Bloom filter structures that added 35+ Redis-compatible commands, and reviewed 50+ pull requests from other contributors.

name: Analyzing Open Source Communities
description: With one teammate, collected and analyzed 500K records from Reddit and GitHub across 15 developer communities, scoring sentiment with VADER and toxicity with a moderation API, then built a Streamlit dashboard to show how welcoming each community is to newcomers.

name: Document Search with Lucene
description: Two Java apps exploring how search engines work: an indexer that extracts text from a folder of documents with Apache Tika and indexes it with Lucene, and a searcher that queries the index using Lucene's default BM25 ranking.

name: Http Server using Go
description: A simple http server built from scratch using Go.

name: Codespeed
description: A web app that helps users improve their typing speed and accuracy.

name: AgilityCoach
description: Agility and reaction-time training at home, built in 24 hours with a team of three using OpenCV motion tracking. Won 3rd Best Hack at HackBU24.
